title: Bounty Bench
subtitle: Code bounties that pay on the diff, not on the maintainer's mood
voice: Bounty Bench. Code bounties that pay on the diff, not on the maintainer's mood. Built on GenLayer.

caption: A live board on GenLayer StudioNet: escrowed rewards, frozen criteria, a fixed claim queue.
voice: This is the live board on StudioNet. Every bounty has escrowed rewards, frozen acceptance criteria, and a claim queue whose order can't be edited.

caption: Scout an issue: validators draft criteria a diff can prove, and reject vague issues.
voice: Start by scouting an issue. Paste a GitHub issue, and validators draft criteria that a code diff can actually prove. Vague issues are rejected as unactionable.

caption: Three live bounties on real bugs. The Hunt guide takes you from faucet to claim.
voice: Three live bounties on real bugs are open right now. The Hunt guide takes you from the faucet to a claim, and checks your commit in the browser before you spend a bond.

caption: Validators fetch the pinned diff and judge one criterion at a time, with quote and digest.
voice: When a claim comes in, validators fetch the pinned diff and judge one criterion at a time, with an exact quote and a digest you can verify yourself.

caption: Winner paid by code after a finalized verdict. Remaining bonds refund in steps.
voice: The winner is paid by contract code after a finalized verdict, and the remaining bonds are refunded in safe steps.

caption: Stuck bounties always close: repeat Close until CLOSED, 21 of 21 refunded.
voice: Nothing gets stuck. If a bounty is closing, just press close again. Here, all twenty-one claims were refunded across two calls.

title: Try it: bounty-bench.vercel.app
subtitle: Every contract, transaction and verdict is on the StudioNet Explorer
voice: Try it at bounty-bench dot vercel dot app. Every contract, transaction, and verdict is on the StudioNet Explorer.
